output.title: ClusterIssuer short name addition may affect cert-manager
output.content: The upstream change adds a `ciss` short name for the cert-manager `ClusterIssuer` resource. Your environment is upgrading cert-manager and has cert-manager.io/v1 apiVersion in use, indicating cert-manager is active. The environment summary does not explicitly list the `ClusterIssuer` CRD, but cert-manager typically includes it by default. Inspect your cluster for installed cert-manager CRDs (run `kubectl get crds | grep cert-manager`) to confirm whether `ClusterIssuer` is present; if so, the short name becomes available for use in kubectl commands.
